title: The Telangana Advocates Welfare Fund Act, 1987.
full_text: The Telangana Advocates Welfare Fund Act, 1987. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 33 Enactment Date: 1987-07-23 Act Year: 1987 Short Title: The Telangana Advocates Welfare Fund Act, 1987. Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of a Welfare Fund for the benefit of advocates in the State of Telangana and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Law Type: State Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Disqualifications and removal of Elected Members of Welfare Committee. Section 6. Resignation by elected member of the Committee and filling up of casual vacancies. Section 7. Act of Committee not to be invalidated by defect, etc. Section 8. Vesting and application of Fund. Section 9. Function of the Committee. Section 10. Borrowing and investment of Funds. Section 11. Power and duties of Secretary. Section 12. Printing, Custody and Distribution of the Andhra Pradesh Advocates' and their Clerks Welfare Fund Stamp. Section 12-A. Apportionment of sale proceeds and the cost of Printing of Stamps. Section 13. Recognition and Registration of Bar Association. Section 14. Duties of Bar Association. Section 15.
